angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 570,474 km at 110.73 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.0312 +/- 0.0111 mas (same row, RUWE 0.85): 110.73 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.82 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Persson et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract): 570,474 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.876 +/- 0.038 solar masses from Persson et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5230 +/- 60 K from Persson et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Persson et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1438.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.553, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1438 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 V, from Persson et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1438 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.03 dex, from Persson et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1438 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.34679, from Persson et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1438 (pscomppars): age 2.2 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1438 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.8 km/s, from Persson et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
